_purpose:
Sprint 12 / A3 — T1 影子期：sandbox.passed / sandbox.failed 双 topic 事件化 e2e。
  跑嵌套 sandbox plugin 的 runSmoke() happy path → publish sandbox.passed → 订阅方（agint-quality-policy）记录 audit log；
  跑嵌套 sandbox plugin 的 runSmoke() fail path → publish sandbox.failed + reason 字段 → 订阅方 audit log。
  双轨不切流量：直连 sandbox.runSmoke() return 结果不受 publish 失败影响。
_note_subscribers: agint-quality-policy async 订阅 sandbox.passed + sandbox.failed（mode=async, 不需要 reason 非空）
_note_assertions: sandbox publish sandbox.passed envelope 落到 bus inspect log
sandbox publish sandbox.failed envelope + reason 字段落到 bus inspect log
直连 sandbox.runSmoke() return ok 不变

_steps: 1. 加载真 agint-event-bus apply(ctx) — 提供 3 service
2. mock 上游 services (evo + memory + quality + metrics + toolStats + rules + qualitySandbox + storageDomain)
3. 加载真 agint-quality-policy apply(ctx) — 自动订阅 sandbox.passed/failed (mode=async)
4. 加载真嵌套 sandbox plugin apply(ctx) — 提供 agint.qualitySandbox.runSmoke + publishSandboxEvent
5. 直连 sandbox.runSmoke happy target (allowInProcessFallback=true → in-process ok=true) → publish sandbox.passed → policy 收到 audit log
6. 直连 sandbox.runSmoke failing target (smoke.js 内置 fail) → publish sandbox.failed + reason → policy 收到 audit log + reason 字段正确
7. 等 microtask 让 async handler fire-and-forget 入栈
8. 校验 inspect 日志 + policy audit log + 直连 runSmoke return 结果
